args.description: Pixel Heaven fantasy RPG building sprite. NATIVE crisp 1px PIXEL ART, NOT a flat front elevation. Camera slightly above at THREE-QUARTER angle: visible front wall AND right side wall AND top roof planes, convincing volumetric depth. Upper-left sunlight, brighter front plane, darker right wall, strong deep shadows under eaves, layered material shading, warm restrained palette. Orthographic camera with no lens distortion. A substantial fantasy civic town hall, broad TWO-STORY half-timbered structure with a stepped blue-slate roof, projecting central entrance bay and a square CLOCK TOWER. Distinct civic silhouette, asymmetrical roof volumes, prominent corner beams, stone foundation no higher than 4px, broad front facade and clearly visible right side receding in depth. Recessed adult scale south doorway about 44px high and 24px wide. Upper story windows, substantial projecting eaves. No church symbols. Single entire building isolated on true transparent background. Bottom-centred foundation/ground anchor, leave only 1px clearance at bottom. No separate isometric diamond of terrain, no lawn, no scenery, no text, no UI, no grid, no checkerboard. Keep whole silhouette inside native canvas. High quality richly detailed game sprite, clear architectural shape, no smooth rendering, no enlarged pixels.

postProcessing: Uniform integer translation of the complete static object to bottom-centred pivot. No scaling, redraw, per-pixel change or alpha loss.
